scope.summary: Convert live Loom original and derivative writers/readers to ArtifactStore, preserving asset identities, references, routes, Range and recoverable migration. This is implementation scope, not a deferred separate WP.
scope.shared_file_merge_plan: Parent edits shared storage/API/workflows/schema files only after MT064 is ready and the active Cargo batch ends; source stable during proof. Any additional integration file must be declared before editing.
non_goals: No Studio implementation or canonical spec edit
No private catalog or third blob tier
No automatic deletion/reset of existing databases
No foreign process interruption or artifact cleanup

acceptance.requirement: All production original, thumbnail, preview and proxy byte producers/consumers use canonical ArtifactStore bindings; legacy paths remain only as explicit migration input.
Preserve existing asset IDs, workspace scope, block/collection/knowledge/proxy/tier references, MIME, length, classification and exportability.

Verify legacy hash/size, materialize and verify destination, atomically publish binding/event with expected-state and idempotency controls, then canonically reread. Retry every interrupted boundary safely; never retire unverified legacy bytes.
Preserve content/thumbnail/tier routes and full/explicit/open-ended/suffix/clamped/unsatisfiable Range status, bytes and headers; corruption outside a selected range fails closed.
Keep schema revision/pins and assertions coherent. Existing unsupported database lineage fails closed without reset; any supported upgrade must be governed and independently proven.

Real embedded-store/on-disk proof executes without skip, covers migration/concurrency/corruption/retry, and proves no new production legacy-tier writes. Independent source review and validator handoff required.

public_api.policy: New Loom binding interfaces serve canonical ArtifactStore migration on existing asset rows; preserve Asset/NewAsset and existing HTTP interfaces.

groups.basis: Typed reservation/readiness and binding policy; VerifiedLoomArtifact fields are crate-visible only and constructed after actual filesystem verification.
Database interface implemented by guarded SurrealDatabase and consumed by Loom byte migration helpers.
Used by production Loom import/content/thumbnail routes and preview workflow; explicit migration is tested with real embedded storage and disk.

patterns: Database transactions protect catalog/event/idempotency records, not filesystem writes.
Digest, length and MIME bind content identity; completed transfer alone is not verification.
Preserve HTTP Range semantics; whole-object hash requires whole-object verification before a slice is served.
research_basis.selected_approach: Reuse canonical ArtifactStore materialization and verification, then transactionally bind the existing Loom asset identity with expected-state protection and event/idempotency evidence. Canonically reread binding and bytes before any legacy retirement. Preserve all original/derivative references and routes.
reuse: ArtifactStore streaming write, manifests and verified reads
stage_artifacts request-hash idempotency and catalog/event transaction pattern
Loom tier selection and Range HTTP tests
rejected: Deleting originals before independent destination proof
Assuming database rollback undoes filesystem writes
risks: Crash leaves incomplete destination or orphan
Full-object verified Range reads incur buffering cost
mitigations: Resumable idempotent migration; retain old bytes until canonical proof
Typed fail-closed errors; preserve damaged source for diagnosis
Use governed schema/pin surface; no implicit reset or unproven upgrade claim
Preserve existing behavior and document measured resource limits
research_basis.validation: Real embedded database and on-disk ArtifactStore; crash/retry boundaries, original and derivative identity/reference preservation, concurrent publication, full and Range HTTP bytes/headers, corruption outside requested range. No skipped embedded setup may count as pass.
